note: Curated descriptive names for the decompiled flat DOS/4G image (stage 07). Addresses are image-relative (flat image imported at base 0). These are OUR analysis conclusions: each entry is added as its meaning is established from reading decompiled.c, and the docs/ notes carry the evidence. g_mode_flag gates init in main and toggles behavior across many subsystems; exact semantics TBD. The RNG names (rng_*) and galaxy-gen names (galaxy_*) are documented in docs/mechanics/rng.md and docs/mechanics/galaxy-creation.md. galaxy_create makes a new galaxy node (rolls type/planet-count/seed); galaxy_place finds a free arena grid slot and sets the node position; galaxy_gen_start_values rolls the 10 per-planet starting values into +0x6c; galaxy_setup_start_values copies them from a same-type galaxy, a static table, or an RNG perturbation; galaxy_rank_start_values scores the ten values against the per-slot divisor table and stores the best index at +0x53; obj_list_pop removes and returns the head node of an intrusive list.
